newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Property firm to take over Perfect Food.
newsitem.headline: Property firm to take over Perfect Food.

text.p: Malaysia's Perfect Food Industries Bhd said on Monday it has entered into an agreement to buy 91 percent equity stake in a property firm which will result in a reverse takeover of the company.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the food products firm said the purchase price for the stake in Segi Objektif (M) Sdn Bhd (SOSB) has not been determined.
Perfect said under the agreement, a valuer will assess SOSB's assets before a purchase price is agreed upon.
SOSB, controlled by businessman Mustapha Kamal Abu Bakar, is developing a waterfront property project on 1,600 acres of land in northern Penang state.
The development will feature, commercial, leisure, recreational and residential facilities facing fresh water Bukit Merah Lake.
The exchange said Perfect's shares will be requoted from Thursday, January 16.
The stock was suspended from January 7, being last traded at 12.30 ringgit, just off its year-high of 12.40.
